rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, 2008).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 2008 as 'Gold Spice'.
rows.Bloom: Golden-yellow, amber center. Double (17-25 petals), classic hybrid tea bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, dense, rounded.

Height: 33" (85cm). Width: up to 32" (up to 80cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders or container rose. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
